37 weeks and 6 days = (37 × 7) + 6 = 259 + 6 = 265 days.  
Start date: 1339-08-02 (Gregorian).  
Add 265 days:  
August 1339 has 31 days → from Aug 2: 29 days left → after Aug: 1339-08-31.  
265 - 29 = 236 days remain.  
September (30), October (31), November (30), December (31) = 122 days → 236 - 122 = 114 days into 1340.  
1340 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rules apply).  
January 31, February 29, March 31 = 91 days → 114 - 91 = 23 days into April.  
April 23, 1340.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1340-04-23
